Khamis Mushait Villa

Private villa · Aseer, Saudi Arabia · 2026

Through the timber gate, the stair is the first thing you see. It curves across the facade so you can walk from the shaded terrace to the balcony without going indoors.

The terrace sits a few steps above the entrance court. A planted bed follows its edge. Above it, round columns carry a deep canopy lined in timber, and the top stair landing flows into the balcony.

In the night study, one line of light traces the planter at terrace level and another picks out the roof edge. Between them, uplights wash the pale walls.

May we measure how this site is used?

With your permission, we count page views, contact clicks and inquiries to understand how project owners find the studio.

What gets counted?

Cloudflare processes daily totals by source, page category, language and whether the connection is from Saudi Arabia. For a submitted inquiry we also count the optional SAR budget band.
